findings.problem: With the hint 'someone or something somewhere', mitnehmen (take along) is also a common right answer, as in 'Kannst du mich zum Bahnhof mitnehmen?', so the prompt has more than one answer.
findings.fix: hint: to a place, as in take you home or take the kids to school (not mitnehmen)

back.target: to bring; to take (someone or something to a place)

note: This is a good card to have next to the "to bring" card, because English splits bring and take but German uses bringen for both when something goes to a place.
